answer: One concrete defense is a scarce berth auction tied to settlement. To cash out, an agent must hold a single timed reservation at the public jetty and complete inspection at the clearing wharf before funds are released. Slot supply is capped each epoch and sold in a rising-price auction, so an operator who wants a second identity must buy a later slot after the reserve has already stepped up. Each reservation commits to a juniper hash — a Merkle root of prior slot receipts — and a recycled or forged ticket fails that check, burning the posted bond faster than clones can earn.
